title: Aam Panna
subtitle: Raw mango cooked with jaggery and ginger into a tangy concentrate — the classic summer cooler.
protein: A cooler, not a protein source

method.title: Cook the mango
items: Cover and cook on medium until the mango is fully cooked and soft, 20–25 min
Cool completely, then peel off the skin
Scrape all the pulp from the skin and stones into the cooking liquid, making sure the skin has separated

method.label: Toddler — keep her share (before the green chili)
items: Spoon {=2 tbsp} of the sweet mango pulp into a small jar for her
To serve: stir {=1 tbsp} of it into {=½ cup} of cool water — no masala, no ice

method.title: Grind the panna
items: Add {@green-chili} to the rest of the pulp
Grind to a smooth paste in a grinder jar
Refrigerate in a clean jar; it keeps about a week
Use 1 heaped spoonful (about {=2 tbsp}) per glass

method.title: Serve
items: In a tall glass, take a spoonful of aam panna and add {@ice}

method.label: Tip
method.text: The green chili used to cook with the mango; it's now ground in afterwards, so the toddler's share stays mild. From Chef Ranveer Brar's panna trio — see also guava panna and pineapple panna, all seasoned with the same panna masala.
